chunks: Say: 'The Spirit of Holiness has sent it down from your Lord with truth, to strengthen those who believe, and as guidance and good news for the Muslims.'

key_terms.رُوحُ الْقُدُسِ: The Holy Spirit (often identified as Gabriel in Shia exegesis)

ai.seo_question: Who is the Ruh al-Qudus that revealed the Quran according to Surah An-Nahl?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, the 'Holy Spirit' (Ruh al-Qudus) is often identified with the Angel Jibril or, more profoundly, with the Prophet Muhammad himself as the bearer of divine truth, emphasizing the continuity of revelation. This verse underscores the Quran's role not merely as text but as a stabilizing force for the faithful, linking the act of revelation directly to spiritual fortitude and guidance. The mention of 'glad tidings' (bushra) resonates with the Shia concept of the Imamate as a source of divine comfort and certainty for the believers.
